$comment: Map markers (WORK_QUEUE item 53, docs/MAP_MARKERS.md; owner 2026-11-12: "Let's use non-Unicode vector style symbols to let you annotate your own map so you can find your way around."). icons: the set a player picks from, each an id (lowercase, the name saved in a marker: a marker keeps its icon's name, so renaming or removing an icon is a change players see, adding one is not), a name (shown in the picker), a path (SVG path data in a 24 x 24 box, absolute commands M L H V C Q A Z only, every point inside the box, filled even-odd: holes are subpaths inside the outline; never an emoji or a Unicode glyph) and colour (its default, a palette name). palette: the colours a marker can take (name, #rrggbb); a marker saves the colour itself, so changing the palette leaves placed markers as they were. auto: the markers the game places by itself, each kind (spawn: where the player first came into the world; death: where they last died, moved on each death; portal: each portal once seen, none in the game yet), on (whether the game places it), keep (one: a single marker moved to the newest place; each: one per place), and its icon, colour and label. limits: maxMarkers (per player per world, the auto ones included), labelChars (a label's most characters), the most bytes of an icon or auto kind name, and pickRadiusPx (a click this close to a marker on the big map picks it). world: the waypoint over a marker's spot in the world, its size (px) and its fade, full at nearM, fadedAlpha from farM on, edgePx (an off-screen marker clamps this far inside the screen's edge) and showM (markers farther than this are not shown in the world, only on the maps); hideWithinM: a marker this close (m, from the eye or across the ground) shows no waypoint, so one under or at the camera is not pinned to the screen's edge (BUGS.md, the spawn's "1 m"). Run `node shared/ui/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if client/src/ui/markers.gen.ts or crates/dwell-protocol/src/markers.gen.rs is stale.
